title: Fema / RBI | Calcutta HC Quashes NPA Classification of CC Account for Failure to Meet 90-Day Test
description: Fema / RBICalcutta High Court quashes NPA classification and Section 13(2) SARFAESI notice after finding that the CC account did not meet the RBI’s 90-day overdue or ‘out of order’ criteria.The post Calcutta HC Quashes NPA Classification of CC Account for Failure to Meet 90-Day Test appeared first on TaxGuru.
